eas_text: A civil authority has issued A REQUIRED WEEKLY TEST for the following counties or areas: New Jersey; at 12:27 PM on AUG 28, 2017 Effective until 1:27 PM. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text: THE NEW JERSEY OFFICE OF EMERGENCY MANAGEMENT IS CONDUCTING A TEST OF THE EMERGENCY ALERT SYSTEM.
